body:
Source: GitHub issue #<n> (<labels>). Re-verified on main @ <sha>: <file>:<line> <the exact code and why it is wrong>. <the repro from the issue, one or two lines, with the observed exit code>.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/<pkg>`: <bin + lib module map, one line each>. Tests: `npm test -w packages/<pkg>` from the worktree root. <fixture helpers worth copying, which existing tests are NOT rails and may change>.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. <the decision: which condition, ONE exported pure predicate/validator in lib used by every call site, exact message text, exit code (0 pass / 1 operational / 2 gate fail)>.
2. <CLI surface: text vs --json output, nothing on stdout on operational error if that is the rule, no manifest record on the new outcome>.
3. <regression guard: what must keep behaving exactly as today>.
4. Documentation: update `packages/<pkg>/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/<pkg>.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/<pkg>.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 <observable behaviour>. verify: `node --test packages/<pkg>/test/<new-test>.test.mjs`
- AC2 <…>. verify: `node --test packages/<pkg>/test/<new-test>.test.mjs`
- AC3 <library-level guard>. verify: `node --test packages/<pkg>/test/<new-test>.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing suite green (if an existing test pins the bug, rewrite it and say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/<pkg>`
- AC5 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "<phrase>" packages/<pkg>/README.md docs/tools/<pkg>.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/<pkg>.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: <sibling issues in the same package that must not be folded in>.
